title: Battle with the Holy Maiden
summary: Ye Fan comes out of a broken Domain Gate still somewhere in the Southern Region, where Ji Haiyue, Ziyue's fifth brother, ambushes him with his 'Jade Ice and Snow' to punish him for stealing the Ji family's secret art. Yao Xi steps in to remind Ye Fan of his promise to go back to Yaoguang, saying the Holy Land has ordered her to bring him and that the Holy Body needs the source Yaoguang mines in the north. When he refuses, she seals his Bitter Sea with her Moon Palace so his divine power slowly drains away, and fights him through an incarnation. Ye Fan shatters her Golden Light Fortress with its own Yaoguang technique, joking about levers and 'lifting the earth', and grabs her incarnation, but he is found afterwards with every bone broken, clutching her outer robe. Slavers pick him up to sell as a labourer in the Northern Territory, and he plays along, joking that he fought the Holy Maiden for 300 rounds. Recruiters working with Yaoguang herd the captives through a gate, and Ye Fan ends up in a Yaoguang source mine in the north.
